material.title: Archaic Administrative Texts from Uruk: The Early Campaigns
material.responsibility: Robert K. Englund; with a contribution by Rainer M. Boehmer
material.edition_or_resource: Archaische Texte aus Uruk, Band 5; Ausgrabungen der Deutschen Forschungsgemeinschaft in Uruk-Warka, Band 15; Berlin: Gebr. Mann, 1994
material.requested_portion: Tier 1: exact front matter, table of contents, and the catalog or plate ranges that explicitly identify tablets containing only numerical signs, together with current copying and local-research terms. Tier 2, only if lawful: a bounded packet covering those catalog/concordance/transliteration/sign-glossary sections and representative numerical-only plates. A complete local research copy is welcome only if the institution can lawfully supply it under explicit conditions.

rights_holder_or_institution.name: German Archaeological Institute, Orient Department Library

research_purpose: Establish exact bibliographic, tablet-membership, catalog, plate, and notation provenance for the numerical-only proto-cuneiform material published in ATU 5; compare source-visible coordinates with current CDLI, PCSL/ACN, and Unicode representations without collapsing physical artifacts, marks, sign identities, values, metrological systems, translations, or interpretations.
requested_format: Lawful reading-room access or a source-faithful PDF scan with stable page and plate order and explicit copying, local OCR/transcription, indexing, embedding, quotation, retention, and research-use conditions. A smaller bounded numerical-text packet is preferred when complete copying is not lawful. No public source-file hosting or redistribution is requested.

local_storage_conditions.retention_posture: Retain only under supplied institutional or rights conditions; preserve fixity and provenance metadata; keep source bytes local and removable; publish neither the source file nor restricted pages, plates, images, line art, or derivatives.
